last_handoff.completed_in_this_session: The security engagement, end to end and merged. Read security-review.md at the repo root FIRST: CLAUDE.md carries a banner telling every session to, until sign-off. Twelve findings became fifteen; ten are closed, no CRITICAL, and both HIGHs are closed with production confirmation. Merged as b7be77e (--no-ff, so revertable), rollback tag pre-security-hardening-2026-08-23 = 05872e0. Fixed: F-01 (the address token, an order's only authorisation, rode in the /thanks URL so gtag reported it to GA4 as page_location - now claimed into an HttpOnly cookie by src/proxy.ts with a 303 to a clean path; closed fully by the founder rotating STORE_SIGNING_SECRET, proven by the old KH-YPJ8-GHVT email link now dying), F-02 (Next 16.2.10 to 16.2.12: four HIGH advisories including a proxy-layer bypass), F-03 (every security header, CSP in Report-Only, phase one of two), F-05 (webhook rows keep an allow-listed summary, not the payer's email, phone and card metadata; founder pruned the old rows), F-06 (markPaid refuses an amount below the order's, as a condition on the atomic UPDATE), F-07 (health throttled), F-08, F-10 (JSON-LD escaped), F-14 (every throttle keyed on the caller-suppliable first entry of x-forwarded-for). Founder also closed F-04 with a Vercel Firewall rule on the pre-order POSTs, and set GA4 retention to 14 months. Same day, earlier: the Ideabaaz tier row went in and that page is LIVE at the exclusive price, verified on production (struck-through 499, 'Pay 99 and reserve', 4,900 on dispatch, zero 4,500).
